title: A page built in the browser
author: Grace Hopper
content:
## A page built in the browser

This article only exists after its JavaScript runs. A static fetch sees an empty root element, so the hidden webview renders it and Defuddle reads the result.

- Rendered locally
- Converted to Markdown

That is enough text to count as readable, and more than the static shell offered by a wide margin, which is the point of the fallback.
